root_task: T15 preparation only; execution requires separate stable-source authorization
public_schema_source: B9 domain/contracts.py only; this document is test criteria
requirements: 默认完整八项和固定附件不得削减，显式subset受理但不可静默扩展/假成包。
实际主转写输入真实最终mixed或登记MP4解码音轨，参考稿不供模型。
可信runtime/model/audio/decoded identity须与独立实物和冻结资源核对，不只metadata自洽。
无可信独立标注/听审或authority时alignment_required阻断；不伪造P95、confidence、frame evidence。
MM03语句P95<=200000us；本候选nearest-rank/max-start-end算法需独立批准，不冒词级验收。
MM05至少30选题60作品固定人工标注；precision>=0.90并报告recall/refusal，全拒答不能通过。
媒体全部真实decode/bytehash与有序关联；独立AV另提供真实视听收据。
成功Bundle/Step/Run/Production/outbox同一短事务，文件先不可变持久化；真实崩溃不半包。
完整export与projection区别；import保持origin字节，本地locator权限独立，不依赖embedding。
未知生成或不确定child cleanup不得settled/确定失败/refund或publish，不盲重交。
未来actual launch之前归档所有声明生产正文/测试正文，hash匹配；不补T14历史正文。

precision_computation_candidate.population: all independently annotated utterance IDs in fixed audio; no cherry-picking
precision_computation_candidate.reference: human annotations plus adjudication hash fixed out of band
precision_computation_candidate.word_level: separate approved criterion required; not inherited

evidence_classification.preparation: AST/own bytes/dicts/ZIP helpers, never product approval
evidence_classification.mechanism: controlled fault/subprocess output injection, not real ASR/model quality
evidence_classification.real_physical_delivery: actual tool/asset/ASR/byte/API/ZIP/import evidence; requires human precision benchmark
evidence_classification.independent_av: actual watch/listen evidence, not ffprobe/ASR substitution
evidence_classification.autonomous_creation: separate real authorised model orchestration; template package not equivalent

source_archive_policy.before_product_launch: exact approved criteria/fixtures and final producer/runtime dependency hashes plus producer source bodies
source_archive_policy.scope: declare all consumed producer sources/tools/libs/resources, archive source bodies that are not credentials/config secrets
source_archive_policy.drift: abort before launch, or preserve running red and notify owner; no mixed freeze
source_archive_policy.historical_limit: T14 hash-only source gaps retained; future B9 body not labelled T14
